id_text: Aku gk sempet ngerjain PR, nanti aja ya.
en_text: I didn't have time to do the homework; later, okay?

id_text: Filmnya bagus bgt, wajib nonton.
en_text: The movie is really good, you have to watch it.

id_text: Udh sampe rumah belum?
en_text: Have you gotten home yet?

id_text: Tp kuota aku abis, ntar aku wifi dulu.
en_text: But my data is out; I'll use wifi later.

id_text: Jgn lupa bawa ktp, kalo ga gabisa masuk.
en_text: Don't forget to bring your ID card, otherwise you can't get in.

id_text: Lagi di jalan, macet bgt di tol.
en_text: I'm on the way; traffic on the toll road is really bad.

id_text: Yg kemarin itu udh dibayar belum?
en_text: Has yesterday's one been paid already?

id_text: Gpp, aku tunggu di depan indomaret.
en_text: It's fine, I'll wait in front of the mini-market.

id_text: Bsk pagi jam 7 aja, jgn kesiangan.
en_text: Tomorrow morning at 7 is fine; don't oversleep.

id_text: Aku lg capek, gabisa telpon dulu.
en_text: I'm tired right now, I can't call yet.

id_text: Kalo ada diskon ksh tau aku ya.
en_text: If there's a discount, let me know.

id_text: Emg dia udh konfirmasi atau blom?
en_text: Has he actually confirmed, or not yet?

id_text: Hrg nya mahal bgt sih, mending yg lain.
en_text: The price is really expensive; better pick another one.

id_text: Aku ntar transfer, no rek nya dong.
en_text: I'll transfer later; send the account number.

id_text: Ujan deres, aku nunggu di halte dulu.
en_text: It's pouring; I'll wait at the bus stop first.

id_text: Skalian beliin es teh, aku haus bgt.
en_text: While you're at it, buy iced tea too; I'm really thirsty.

id_text: Dia balesnya lama bgt, aku udh wa 3x.
en_text: He replies really slowly; I've already sent three WhatsApp messages.

id_text: Gtw kenapa aplikasinya lemot parah.
en_text: I don't know why the app is so laggy.

id_text: Otws, 5 mnt lg nyampe.
en_text: On the way, I'll be there in five minutes.

id_text: Mager bgt keluar, makan di rumah aja yuk.
en_text: I'm too lazy to go out; let's just eat at home.
